text: {"memo": "As of March 31, 2025, Tesla’s most recently completed fiscal year was fiscal 2024. In FY2024, Tesla reported revenue of $97.69 billion, up about 19% from $96.77 billion in FY2023, and net income of $7.09 billion, or diluted EPS of $1.29, versus $5.52 billion and $0.72 in FY2023. FY2023 revenue was $96.77 billion, up from $81.46 billion in FY2022, with net income of $5.52 billion and EPS of $0.72. FY2022 revenue was $81.46 billion, net income was $12.56 billion, and diluted EPS was $3.96. Tesla’s operating cash flow in FY2024 was about $21.0 billion, with free cash flow around $18.3 billion, and operating margin was roughly 12%. FY2024 profit recovered versus FY2023, but remained below the margin and earnings intensity of FY2022. The year showed resilient revenue growth, yet margin normalization and softer earnings power continued. View: On March 31, 2025, the stock may look expensive relative to these FY2024 results, which showed growth but recovering profitability."}
